bugs.what: Room text says 'a chapel roof south' but the room's own exit list is only 'W E' — there is no south exit anywhere to reach the described chapel roof, so the described landmark is unreachable from where it's described.
bugs.where: The Chapel Causeway (Pennywell approach) / room description vs exits list

bugs.what: Doran tells you 'Four names went in with the last melt before the sealing,' then the wits check reveals only three: 'Corbet, Wyle, and Hann, struck last, then nothing after' — the promised count (four) doesn't match the delivered list (three).
bugs.where: The Assayer's Cot, Pennywell / 'ask for the moneyers' names'

bugs.what: After the vault burns, Sarel says 'Hann's own die is ash and melt now, same as the rest of him' — but the exact reverse die she personally handed me earlier ('She hands it over both-handed... he hands it over') is sitting safely in my pack the whole time, confirmed by its own item text later ('the vault burned through; nothing left to strike — a keepsake', i.e. still intact). She reacts as if her family's die was destroyed when it demonstrably wasn't; nothing distinguishes 'the die I kept' from 'other dies that stayed in the vault' in her line.
bugs.where: The Hammer Hearth, Pennywell / talk to Sarel, 'the vault, now it's burned'

bugs.what: The Ironbound oil cask used to burn the Hollow Throne (the ending action) is still listed in the final carried-items recap after being spent — 'cask of Ironbound oil (enough to burn a throne)' — unlike the earlier cinder-oil cask at Pennywell's vault door, which was correctly removed from inventory the moment it was used.
bugs.where: status, final screen, carrying list / after 'burn the throne with the oil you carry'

bugs.what: Robin (who found the river penny) and Sarel (whose family's die was used) never get a line reacting to the final 'Pennywell's Coin' decision once it's made — only Meva and Doran, the two NPCs actually consulted for the decision, get follow-up dialogue ('the coin, now its face is decided'). The two townsfolk most personally tied to the coin's history are silent on the outcome.
bugs.where: The Mint Yard / talk to Robin, and The Hammer Hearth / talk to Sarel, both after 'Pennywell's Coin' quest completion

bugs.what: 'order the muster off the common (free; as a Warden)' cost Free Companies standing (-1) on top of the Watch +1 it advertised, but the option text only flagged 'free' (no turn cost) — every other costed choice I saw named the faction at risk in the option label itself; this one didn't.
bugs.where: The Staked Common, Wickstead (Fallows) / 'order the muster off the common'

confusions: Despite finishing a full win with two companions (Vell, Tamsin) through dozens of shared decision points, I never once saw a 'both companions look at you' quarrel prompt or the 'entry to leave a quarrel between them' the brief specifically asked me to try — it may need a third companion or specific locations I skipped (Wickstead's 'Whose Ground', the Meres' 'Old Dams', the Kings' Rest), but nothing in-game signals what triggers it.

Quest text for 'Perrin's Mother' ('Tell his mother in Reedholm, as you promised her') stays listed as a live, biddable promise all the way to the end screen, but the moment you cross the one-way Pass Gate toward Marrowgate it becomes physically impossible to fulfil; the gate's warning is generic ('a companion's grief left unfinished... stays unfinished') and never names which specific standing promises are about to be stranded.

The 'travel to a known place' list only ever offers a handful of named landmark hubs, never the dozens of ordinary rooms actually visited between them (confirmed intentional by the opening tutorial line, but easy to forget mid-game when a menu unexpectedly shrinks from '9 known places' to a short named list after grouping by region).
suggestions: Give Sarel a distinct line when the burn happens while you're holding her family's die, acknowledging it survived (vs. the version where you never asked her for it).
Fix Doran's 'four names' to say three, or add the missing fourth moneyer to the touchstone read.
Add a south exit (or drop the mention) for the chapel roof at The Chapel Causeway.
Clear a spent single-use quest item (the Ironbound throne-oil cask) from the carried-items list the same way the Pennywell cinder-oil cask was cleared.
Let Robin and Sarel react once to the finished coin decision, even a one-line callback, since Meva and Doran already do.
Name the standing cost in the option label for 'order the muster off the common,' matching every other costed Warden choice.
Surface the quarrel/'both look at you' mechanic at least once on a common path (e.g. tie one to an early Vale choice) so a two-companion, single-playthrough game reliably sees it.
